LightningComponentBundle.description: Lookup that lets a user pick a single Contact related to a given Account via AccountContactRelation.

property.name: accountId
property.label: Account Id
property.description: Id of the Account whose related contacts should be searchable. Pass the recordId output of the Account_Lookup component.

property.name: selectedContactId
property.label: Selected Contact Id
property.description: Id of the contact the user selected.

property.name: selectedContactName
property.label: Selected Contact Name
property.description: Name of the contact the user selected.
